headline.text: A trial found abiraterone plus prednisone roughly doubled dextromethorphan exposure.

reported.text: Dextromethorphan Cmax and AUC24h ratios fell outside the bioequivalence limit.
The EMA abiraterone label reports approximately 2.9-fold higher dextromethorphan exposure in a study of abiraterone acetate plus prednisone.

claims.text: In a trial in men with prostate cancer, abiraterone acetate plus prednisone increased dextromethorphan systemic exposure by approximately 100%.
claims.quote: Coadministration of abiraterone acetate plus prednisone increased the systemic exposure of dextromethorphan by approximately 100%.
claims.judgeRationale: Trial abstract states abiraterone acetate plus prednisone increased dextromethorphan exposure by about 100%.

claims.text: In the same trial, dextromethorphan Cmax and AUC24h ratios were 275% and 268%, outside the bioequivalence limit.
claims.quote: Ratios of geometric means for maximum plasma concentration (C(max)) (275.36%) and area under plasma concentration-time curves from time 0 to 24 h (AUC(24h)) (268.14%) of dextromethorphan were outside the bioequivalence limit.
claims.judgeRationale: Abstract gives Cmax and AUC24h ratios of 275% and 268% outside bioequivalence limits.

claims.text: The EMA abiraterone label reports approximately 2.9-fold higher dextromethorphan exposure in a study of abiraterone acetate plus prednisone.
claims.quote: In a study to determine the effects of abiraterone acetate (plus prednisone) on a single dose of the CYP2D6 substrate dextromethorphan, the systemic exposure (AUC) of dextromethorphan was increased approximately 2.9 fold.
claims.judgeRationale: Independent Claude Opus 5.5 review against the full EMA SmPC section 4.5, supplied in the implementation brief: supports the claim.
